messages:
maria: Heads up — customer reported double charge when a streaming request fell back regions and a tool_call retried after truncation. Minimal repro below. Anyone own router or ledger?
kevin: Oof. Logs? model/region? sounds like idempotency got lost on replay.
ash: saw a route-handoff at 12:03:17 where session_id changed. that's probably the trigger.
maria: relevant log snippet:```
2024-09-11T12:03:16Z INFO router route=us-west-2 -> us-east-1 session=abcd-1234 toolcall=tc-9876 prefix_tokens=42
2024-09-11T12:03:17Z WARN runtime truncate-triggered session=abcd-1234 -> new_session=efgh-5678 truncated=true
2024-09-11T12:03:17Z INFO router replay-toolcall toolcall=tc-9876 session=efgh-5678 charging=provisional
2024-09-11T12:03:18Z INFO billing confirm-charge toolcall=tc-9876 session=efgh-5678 charged_tokens=42
2024-09-11T12:03:18Z INFO billing confirm-charge toolcall=tc-9876 session=abcd-1234 charged_tokens=42
```
ash: two confirms for same toolcall id but different sessions. that's double-bill.
samir: ledger currently tracks provisional credits separately from confirmed. fallback flow created provisional on route A then confirmed again on route B and we ended up charging both.
kevin: short-term mitigation: billing should dedupe confirmed charges by toolcall_id + customer + model and prefer single confirmed charge. That would avoid customer impact until router change ships.
maria: long-term: router should propagate original_toolcall_id across handoffs and avoid generating a fresh session id for mid-stream fallbacks if possible.
kevin: I'll open a router PR to carry X-Original-Toolcall-ID on fallback and add unit tests.
ash: console visibility: can we add route_hops and toolcall_id columns to the provisional charge table (or a toggleable view) so support can triage these faster?
samir: also add billing.trace_id that links provisional->confirmed transitions. telemetry team: an emitted trace will make reconciliation straightforward.
maria: ops-bot, please open an incident and assign to eng-platform oncall so support can contact the customer and we can track refunds.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2024-1123 created: streaming fallback double-charge. Assigned: eng-platform oncall. https://redwood.internal/inc/INC-2024-1123
kevin: timeline: router PR by EOD, console mock for column tomorrow, billing dedupe hotfix target next sprint.
maria: thanks. i'll DM repro ids and ping legal/product about refund policy. :thumbsup:
